statement: Neither pinned consumer reaches the adapter through hidraw. SDL lists 057e:0337 as libusb-required and its HIDAPI layer ignores the device on non-libusb backends; Dolphin opens it only through libusb hotplug and detaches any kernel driver. A UHID realization with the native identity would therefore not be opened by either consumer's adapter path; reaching them needs a USB-level device (for example dummy_hcd or USB/IP).

applicability.scope: consumer discovery and access path on Linux
